Her quoted words back proof of citizenship and voter ID without saying documentary proof at registration; the third-person cosponsorship claim for the SAVE America Act is not the record itself.

rows.reasoning: Houchin cosponsored and voted for final passage of both SAVE Acts (H.R. 8281, 118th, Aye 221-198; H.R. 22, 119th, Yea 220-208), single-subject bills whose operative section provides that a State may not register a voter unless the individual provides documentary proof of United States citizenship. That matches the rung "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote" clause for clause.

quotes.text: The SAVE America Act ensures that only American citizens are voting in American elections. Requiring proof of citizenship and voter ID strengthens trust in our system and ensures that our elections are fair and secure.
